metadata.note: Public dashboard data. Missing values and NASA POWER -999/-9999 placeholders are excluded from calculations. Production share uses PSA 2025 Coconut (w/ husk).

summary.one_liner: 【数据实际截止2026-08-30，不是请求日2026-09-03】截至2026-08-30，菲律宾椰子产区近30天加权降雨约为常年88%，干旱/严重干旱风险覆盖约24.1%成熟椰子产量；未来16天预测降雨对30天降雨亏缺的弥补率约438%，有望明显缓解前期偏干。部分主产区出现干旱风险，需要继续跟踪是否从短期降雨不足转化为持续性产量压力。
summary.detail:
1、观测有效日期：本次请求截止2026-09-03，程序自动剔除-999/空值后，实际分析截止2026-08-30。
2、产区口径：所有监测点按你提供的菲律宾Coconut Mature 2025分省产量设置，地图标签括号内为全国成熟椰子产量占比。
3、近期天气：近30天产区加权降雨约为常年88%，温度距平约0.6℃；干旱/严重干旱风险覆盖24.1%产量，偏干及以上覆盖43.6%产量。
4、风险较高的主产区：Sulu(1.5%，严重干旱风险，降雨34%)；Tawi-tawi(0.9%，严重干旱风险，降雨34%)；Basilan(0.3%，严重干旱风险，降雨33%)；Davao Oriental(4.5%，干旱风险，降雨46%)；Sarangani(4.1%，干旱风险，降雨59%)；Misamis Oriental(3.7%，干旱风险，降雨57%)；Davao Occidental(3.1%，干旱风险，降雨41%)；Davao del Norte(1.6%，干旱风险，降雨58%)
5、未来预测：未来16天预测降雨对30天降雨亏缺的弥补率约438%，有望明显缓解前期偏干。
6、产量影响判断：部分主产区出现干旱风险，需要继续跟踪是否从短期降雨不足转化为持续性产量压力。
7、PAGASA式月度判断：Camarines Sur(2.3%，旱期)；Eastern Samar(1.4%，旱期)；Camarines Norte(0.9%，旱期)；Aurora(0.1%，旱期)；Siquijor(0.1%，旱期)；Pangasinan(0.1%，旱期)；Catanduanes(0.0%，旱期)

official.title: Seasonal Climate Outlook
official.english_core_text: However, the probabilistic forecast suggests a moderate to high probability of above-normal rainfall in most areas of western and northern Luzon, while a moderate probability of below normal is expected over most parts of the Visayas and northern Mindanao. El Niño increases the likelihood of below-normal rainfall conditions , which may lead to dry spells and droughts in some parts of the country. The SW monsoon is expected to persist during this period, bringing widespread and heavy rainfall to the western sections of Luzon and the Visayas. official.title: Monthly Climate Assessment and Outlook
official.english_core_text: Based on observed rainfall during the past months and the forecast for August, meteorological drought/dry spells are likely to be experienced by the end of the month in some areas of Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, and Negros Island Region. El Niño increases the likelihood of below-normal rainfall, which may lead to adverse impacts, including dry spells and droughts in some areas of the country. In addition, nineteen (19) provinces experienced meteorological drought, most of which were in Luzon; two (2) provinces were under dry spells, and three (3) provinces experienced dry conditions. The rainfall forecast for August suggests that above-normal rainfall conditions will be experienced over the western parts of Northern and Central Luzon, and patches of below- normal rainfall are likely over the Bicol Region, Visayas, Caraga, and Zamboanga Peninsula, while near-normal conditions are expected over the rest of the country.
